name: caroline-messenger-sidecar
description: Facebook Messenger personal-account connection for Caroline (docs/MESSENGER_INTEGRATIONS_PLAN.md) -- runs as a child process of the Python backend (app/messenger_channel.py via app/sidecar_process.py), talking newline-delimited JSON over stdio. Uses fca-unofficial (unofficial Facebook Messenger web-protocol client), not an official API -- there isn't one for a personal inbox, only for business Pages.
